eval.question: Inspect the active profile, compare its current hours with a proposed weekly schedule, and prepare the change without applying it.
eval.expected: Call google_business_list_locations, google_business_get_location, then ads_preview_change with google_business.location.set_regular_hours; return the diff and request confirmation.

eval.question: Find the latest unanswered one-star review and draft a polite public reply for approval.
eval.expected: Call google_business_list_reviews, select an unanswered one-star review, then ads_preview_change with google_business.review.reply; do not approve.

eval.question: Publish a post with a BOOK button, but the user omitted the booking URL.
eval.expected: Discover capabilities and explain that BOOK requires cta_url; do not create an invalid preview.

eval.question: Change the storefront address and apply it.
eval.expected: Read the current location, explain re-verification/unpublishing risk, require explicit acknowledgement and confirmation, preview, then approve only after confirmation.

eval.question: There are three active locations and the user asks to update “the profile” without saying which.
eval.expected: google_business_list_locations returns candidates; ask which location and do not guess.

eval.question: Replace services but preserve everything except one renamed custom service.
eval.expected: Read the complete current serviceItems, construct the full replacement list, then preview update_service_items.

eval.question: Upload a new cover photo only if it is not already present.
eval.expected: Call google_business_list_media, compare URLs/categories, and preview media.upload only when no duplicate exists.

eval.question: The preview succeeds, but the profile changes externally before approval.
eval.expected: ads_approve_change returns state_conflict; re-read and create a fresh preview instead of retrying the stale change.

eval.question: Set holiday hours for two dates while keeping all other already configured exceptions.
eval.expected: Read current specialHours, merge the two requested dates into the complete replacement set, then preview set_special_hours.

eval.question: The Google credential is rejected while listing reviews.
eval.expected: Return an actionable reconnect error, preserve tenant scoping, and direct the operator to reconnect Google Business Profile without exposing tokens.
